course_description:
Analysis of statically determinate structures. Section properties, principal axes and Mohr's circle, unsymmetrical bending, torsion of circular shafts. Shear stresses in solid and thin-walled sections. Stress-strain in 2D. Deflection in beams, double integration, virtual work method. Deflection in trusses and frame structures. Influence lines. Column buckling.

This course introduces students to some fundamental aspects of the mechanics of structures. The course content provides a basis on which advanced analysis and design skills are developed in later semesters. The course uses a lecture-tutorial teaching format (3L+2T per week). Attendance of these lectures and tutorials is essential for mastering the concepts and techniques that will be introduced throughout this course. An optional weekly contact hour is also scheduled to provide additional help to students.

course_aims: This course aims to establish the concepts of structural mechanics and to introduce various analysis techniques.

learning_outcomes.description: Analytical: Competently use fundamental theory and analysis techniques to identify and solve problems in structural mechanics.
Conceptual: Understand the concepts of stress and strain, analysis techniques including virtual work and energy methods, and aspects of bending, torsion, deflection and stability.
Critical Thinking: Develop insight into the behaviour of structural elements under a range of load actions.

assessment_details.task_description: Your mark will be determined from the best 8 out of the 10 Assignment submissions. Assignment #1 is concerned with drawing the shear force and bending moment diagrams and the determination of bending stress in a transversely loaded beam. Assignment #2 is concerned with the determination of bending stress in unsymmetrical bending of beams. Assignment #3 is concerned with the determination of shear stress in a transversely loaded beam. Assignment #4 is concerned with the determination of torsional stress and angle of twist in rods. Assignment #5 is concerned with the determination of stress state of an element using Mohr's circle of stress. Assignment #6 is concerned with the determination of deflections of a transversely loaded beam. Assignment #7 is concerned with the determination of joint deflection of a plane truss by using the virtual work method. Assignment #8 is concerned with the determination of deflection of transversely loaded beam by using the virtual work method. Assignment #9 is concerned with the analysis of statically indeterminate structures. Assignment #10 is concerned with the determination of influence line for statically determinate beams.
